description: React component 'PdfExportButton' that provides a button to trigger PDF export functionality for a travel itinerary, including a modal dialog and PDF generation service integration.

methods.name: PdfExportButton({ trip, items })
methods.description: React functional component that renders an export button and manages the export modal and PDF export logic.

parameters.name: trip
parameters.description: Trip data object to be included in the PDF.

parameters.name: items
parameters.description: List of items related to the trip, to be included in the PDF.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Async handler invoked upon confirmation in the modal to generate and export the PDF using the pdfService.
